text:
alex: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's span-loss incident — short thread with owners and timelines.

maria: timeline + impact?

alex: 02:10-02:35 UTC spike. ~12% span loss for inference traces, downstream aggregation lag ~30m. Root trigger: aggregator job OOM after a schema change introduced an unexpected nested field, causing large allocations on a few batches. ETL backlog built until autoscale caught up.

sam: any hotfix we did?

alex: mitigations we ran: scaled aggregator pods x2, reverted the schema push on prod (rollback by @kyle at 03:00 UTC), and enabled a temporary fast-path that skips heavy aggregation for malformed spans to keep downstream metrics flowing.

kyle: I did the rollback and attached heap dump + initial analysis. main fix will be schema validation in the preprocessor. I'll open a PR today.

alex: logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-12T02:12:04Z aggregator ERROR OOM processing batch 4823: field_types mismatch -> allocations spike
2026-03-12T02:12:05Z etl WARN skipping span id=... reason=malformed_schema
2026-03-12T02:14:00Z autoscaler INFO scaled from 3 -> 6 pods
```

natalie: who owns the remediation items? also is this recurring?

alex: owners + tentative ETA:
- kyle: root-cause fix (schema guard + unit tests + PR) — ETA: 3 business days (PR #482 soon).
- maria: ETL backfill & data correctness checks for the window (coord with analytics) — ETA: 2 days after merge.
- sam: observability/playbook (alert, dashboard, runbook) — ETA: 24 hours (will add synthetic replay test).
- natalie: migration checklist + canary plan (audit existing migrations) — ETA: 2 weeks.

sam: I will add alert: `span-loss-rate > 5% for 10m` and a runbook entry: steps to scale aggregator, toggle fast-path, rollback schema. Also adding a synthetic replay job to CI that injects malformed schema.

maria: backfill plan: once PR merged and deploy complete, I'll run staged backfill with `--max-parallel=4` and monitor cardinality diffs. Expect ~6 hours to finish for the affected window. I'll post progress here.

kyle: note on fix: plan to add a lightweight schema validation step in the ingest preprocessor and a circuit-breaker on batch size. Will include metrics for `schema-reject-rate` so we can alert before OOM.

alex: recurring pattern: this is the second schema-related aggregator OOM in 6 weeks. Proposal: require a staging canary for any schema change that touches tracing/aggregation; also add a migration checklist step for data shape changes.

natalie: I can own the migration checklist + canary gating. I'll draft the checklist and proposal by EOD Friday (ETA 2 weeks for full rollout). Will sync with product for freeze window policy.

sam: tagging @eng-sre for capacity planning and cost impact during backfills.

obs-bot: reminder created: check-in for remediation progress in 3 days (1789250000).

alex: action tracker summary (short):
- #1 kyle: schema guard + tests — owner: kyle — ETA: 3 business days — PR link to follow.
- #2 maria: backfill & validation — owner: maria — ETA: 2 days after merge.
- #3 sam: alert/runbook + synthetic replay — owner: sam — ETA: 24h.
- #4 natalie: migration checklist + canary rollout — owner: natalie — ETA: 2w.

sam: ack :thumbsup:

kyle: starting on PR now, will ping when ready for review.

maria: will post pre-backfill checklist here before starting.

alex: one more thing — add a quick dashboard card for "aggregation lag" and a count of "rejected spans by reason" so product/CS can correlate impact.

sam: added to my list.

alex: thanks everyone. keeping this thread as the single source for progress. will close after the 3-day check-in if all items on track. :eyes:
